front: Assess a creature's body language to tell whether it is behaving abnormally or deceptively. The GM rolls secretly.
back:
Secret Perception check vs. the creature's Deception DC (or a mental spell's DC). Can't retry on the same creature until the situation changes significantly.
Crit Success: learn true intentions and get a solid idea of any mental magic affecting it.
Success: know if it's behaving normally, not exact intentions or magic.
Failure: you detect what a deceptive creature wants you to believe.
Crit Failure: false sense of its intentions.
